title: WPSB/239/2009 of MITHILESH JHA Vs HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSB No. 239 of 2009
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Honíble Alok Singh, J.

Mr. Paresh Tripathi, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Mr. Sharad Sharma, Senior Advocate, assisted by Ms. Anjali
Bhargava, Advocate, present for the respondent No.1.
Mr. Paresh Tripathi, learned counsel for the petitioner prays
for and is allowed to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to
make a representation against the adverse remarks recorded
against the petitioner by the Administrative Judge, Udham Singh
Nagar) communicated vide letter No.1875/XIII-i/2/ Admin.
A/2008, dated June 6, 2009.
The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with aforesaid
liberty. (Interim Relief Application No. 9378 of 2009 also stands
disposed of).
